text: {"observations":"The loudness envelope shows near-continuous speech for the whole 14.7 s, with only two short pauses (about 3.8-4.2 s and 10.75-11.05 s). Band levels at 64 ms steps fluctuate rapidly, roughly 4 syllable-like energy bumps per second (e.g. about 15 in 0-3.7 s), so around 50+ syllables and an estimated 35-40 words in total. Voiced pitch sits around 130-180 Hz throughout, consistent with fluent speech at a normal rate. Most words in running speech carry a stressed vowel, so a count near the total word count fits: this rules out three, and makes eleven or fifteen too low for 14 s of dense speech. Thirty-two (B) is the best match; this is an estimate from speech rate, not a direct word count.","answer":"B"}
